summary.text: Kelly Pease is a Republican member of the Massachusetts House of Representatives who has represented the 4th Hampden District since January 2021 and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Pease took office on January 6, 2021, and advanced from the Republican primary on September 1, 2026.

For the 2025-2026 session, he was assigned to the House Committee on Federal Funding, Policy and Accountability, the House Ways and Means Committee, and the Bonding, Capital Expenditures, and State Assets, Higher Education, and Ways and Means joint committees.
